findings.explanation: You are only paid when the client receives payment from wireless carriers, which makes your payment conditional and forces you to wait for third-party collections.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all amounts to the Contractor on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter, regardless of when the Client receives payments from third-party carriers.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request an adjustment to the relevant clause. - Regarding the payment terms, the current wording makes payment conditional on third-party collections and forces a wait for wireless carriers. I propose updating the agreement so that the Client shall pay all amounts to the Contractor on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter, regardless of when the Client receives payments from third-party carriers. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to moving ahead.
